name: MK TIYU News (mktynews.com)
verdict: Deportivo Alavés' Asian main sponsor, rebranded in June 2025 to the sports-news portal MK TIYU News (mktynews.com). No state owner identified. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Ownership is opaque - mktynews.com is an anonymous WordPress site and no primary source names the corporate owner. The claim rests on the club's own rebrand announcement. No state owner appears anywhere in available material.
